description: Customisable settings for the signage-manager app

name.description: Name of the application. Used as the browser tab title when no short name is set.

short_name.description: Short name for the application. Used as the browser tab title prefix and as the application name passed to the PlaceOS API client.

logo_light.description: Logo shown in the navigation sidebar when using the light theme. Either a URL string or an object with a `src` URL.

logo_dark.description: Logo shown in the navigation sidebar when using the dark theme. Either a URL string or an object with a `src` URL.

diagnostics.description: Whether diagnostics are enabled for the application

show_locale_selector.description: Whether to show the locale (language) selector in the navigation sidebar. The selector is only rendered when more than one locale is configured.

show_group_selector.description: Whether to show the signage group selector in the navigation sidebar and mobile navigation menu. Defaults to `false`. The group breadcrumbs in each section header can still be used to change group.

locales.description: List of locales available in the navigation sidebar locale selector.

default_animation_time.description: Default duration for UI animations in milliseconds

media_allow_extended_video_codecs.description: Whether media upload validation accepts extended video codecs — AV1 (`av01`/`V_AV1`) and HEVC (`hev1`/`hvc1`) — in MP4 and WebM files, in addition to the default allowed codec set.

signage_path.description: Base URL path of the signage viewer application, used to build display preview links. Defaults to `/signage`.

id.description: Locale code, e.g. `en` or `fr`. Persisted to local storage when selected.

name.description: Display name for the locale. Supports translation keys.

local.description: Name of the locale in its own language, shown alongside the translated name.
